items.title: Tether-backed Orionx to shut down after audit flags $7M custody gap
items.summary: Tether-backed Orionx is permanently closing after an audit found more than $7 million in customer assets had moved to wallets outside its custody.

items.title: UBS, Jane Street among firms with combined $75 million in Hyperliquid ETF holdings: Bloomberg
items.summary: Brazil's Wealth High Governance Asset Management held about $24 million worth of 21Shares' HYPE fund as of the end of June, the top HYPE ETF holder.

items.title: Timing the bitcoin market is exciting but nearly impossible. Here's why
items.summary: A historical analysis of bitcoin price performance from 2010 through 2026 demonstrates that the vast majority of the asset's annual returns occur during a tiny fraction of the calendar year.
